# ============================================================
# SPARKLINES
# ============================================================

parse_values <- function(x) {

  if (is.na(x) || !nzchar(x)) {
    return(numeric())
  }

  y <- as.numeric(
    strsplit(x, "\\|")[[1]]
  )

  y[is.finite(y)]
}


spark_svg <- function(
  values,
  colour,
  width = 150,
  height = 46
) {

  if (length(values) < 2) {
    return(
      '<span class="no-trend">No trend available</span>'
    )
  }

  x <- seq(
    4,
    width - 4,
    length.out = length(values)
  )

  rng <- range(
    values,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )

  y <- if (diff(rng) == 0) {

    rep(
      height / 2,
      length(values)
    )

  } else {

    4 +
      (max(values) - values) /
      diff(rng) *
      (height - 8)

  }

  points <- paste(
    sprintf("%.1f,%.1f", x, y),
    collapse = " "
  )

  last_x <- sprintf(
    "%.1f",
    tail(x, 1)
  )

  last_y <- sprintf(
    "%.1f",
    tail(y, 1)
  )

  glue(
    '<svg class="sparkline"
          viewBox="0 0 {width} {height}"
          role="img"
          aria-label="Recent trend">

      <polyline
        points="{points}"
        fill="none"
        stroke="{colour}"
        stroke-width="3"
        stroke-linecap="round"
        stroke-linejoin="round"
      />

      <circle
        cx="{last_x}"
        cy="{last_y}"
        r="4"
        fill="white"
        stroke="{colour}"
        stroke-width="3"
      />

    </svg>'
  )
}


# ============================================================
# DASHBOARD SUMMARY ROWS
# ============================================================

status_class <- function(x) {
  paste0("cell-", x)
}


dashboard_row <- function(
  indicator,
  group,
  latest_display,
  month_display,
  year_display,
  base_display,
  latest_status,
  month_status,
  year_status,
  base_status,
  spark_values,
  spark_colour,
  note,
  fuel_row
) {

  fuel_class <- if (
    isTRUE(as.logical(fuel_row))
  ) {
    " fuel-row"
  } else {
    ""
  }

  glue(
    '<div class="summary-row{fuel_class}">

      <div class="indicator-cell">

        <span class="section-kicker">
          {htmlEscape(group)}
        </span>

        <strong>
          {htmlEscape(indicator)}
        </strong>

        <small>
          {htmlEscape(note)}
        </small>

      </div>

      <div class="trend-cell">
        {spark_svg(
          parse_values(spark_values),
          spark_colour
        )}
      </div>

      <div class="
        metric-cell
        latest-cell
        {status_class(latest_status)}
      ">
        {htmlEscape(latest_display)}
      </div>

      <div class="
        metric-cell
        {status_class(month_status)}
      ">
        {htmlEscape(month_display)}
      </div>

      <div class="
        metric-cell
        {status_class(year_status)}
      ">
        {htmlEscape(year_display)}
      </div>

      <div class="
        metric-cell
        {status_class(base_status)}
      ">
        {htmlEscape(base_display)}
      </div>

    </div>'
  )
}


rows <- pmap_chr(

# ============================================================
# DETAIL TABLE FUNCTION
# ============================================================

make_table <- function(
  data,
  highlight_name = NULL,
  highlight_row = NULL,
  min_width = 980
) {

  headers <- paste0(
    "<th>",
    htmlEscape(names(data)),
    "</th>",
    collapse = ""
  )

  body <- map_chr(
    seq_len(nrow(data)),
    function(i) {

      cells <- map_chr(
        seq_along(data),
        function(j) {

          classes <- character()

          if (j == 1) {
            classes <- c(
              classes,
              "row-label"
            )
          }

          if (
            !is.null(highlight_name) &&
            names(data)[j] == highlight_name
          ) {
            classes <- c(
              classes,
              "highlight-column"
            )
          }

          if (
            !is.null(highlight_row) &&
            i == highlight_row
          ) {
            classes <- c(
              classes,
              "highlight-row"
            )
          }

          cls <- if (length(classes)) {

            paste0(
              ' class="',
              paste(
                classes,
                collapse = " "
              ),
              '"'
            )

          } else {

            ""

          }

          glue(
            '<td{cls}>
              {htmlEscape(
                as.character(
                  data[[j]][i]
                )
              )}
            </td>'
          )

        }
      )

      glue(
        '<tr>
          {paste(
            cells,
            collapse = ""
          )}
        </tr>'
      )

    }
  )

  glue(
    '<div class="table-wrap">

      <table
        class="data-table"
        style="min-width:{min_width}px"
      >

        <thead>
          <tr>
            {headers}
          </tr>
        </thead>

        <tbody>
          {paste(
            body,
            collapse = ""
          )}
        </tbody>

      </table>

    </div>'
  )
}

# ============================================================
# CASH-RATE DECISION TABLE
# ============================================================

if (nrow(cash_rate_decisions) > 0) {

  current_year <- format(
    Sys.Date(),
    "%Y"
  )

  cash_tbl <- cash_rate_decisions |>

    mutate(
      effective_date =
        as.Date(effective_date)
    ) |>

    filter(
      format(
        effective_date,
        "%Y"
      ) == current_year
    ) |>

    arrange(
      desc(effective_date)
    ) |>

    mutate(

      `Effective date` =
        format(
          effective_date,
          "%d %b %Y"
        ),

      Decision =
        decision,

      `Change (ppt)` =
        ifelse(
          change_ppt > 0,
          paste0(
            "+",
            sprintf(
              "%.2f",
              change_ppt
            )
          ),
          sprintf(
            "%.2f",
            change_ppt
          )
        ),

      `Cash rate target` =
        paste0(
          sprintf(
            "%.2f",
            cash_rate_target
          ),
          "%"
        )

    ) |>

    select(
      `Effective date`,
      Decision,
      `Change (ppt)`,
      `Cash rate target`
    )

} else {
